definitions.explanation: A suffix indicating a way of viewing or perspective on something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価値|かち}{観|かん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
⟦{人生|じんせい}{観|かん}→人生観：21063_jinseikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
⟦{世界|せかい}{観|かん}→世界観：11312_sekaikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。

notes:
〜{観|かん} is a suffix meaning "view of," "outlook on," or "sense of." It attaches to nouns to create abstract concepts about how one perceives or understands something.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧: values, sense of values
- ⟦{人生観|じんせいかん}→人生観：21063_jinseikan⟧: view of life, philosophy of life
- ⟦{世界観|せかいかん}→世界観：11312_sekaikan⟧: worldview
- {歴史観|れきしかん}: view of history
- ⟦{自然観|しぜんかん}→自然観：29851_shizenkan⟧: view of nature
- ⟦{倫理観|りんりかん}→倫理観：23419_rinrikan⟧: ethical sense, moral outlook
- ⟦{死生観|しせいかん}→死生観：21811_shiseikan⟧: view of life and death

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{観|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: one's view of ~ changes
- 〜{観|かん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold a view of ~
- 〜{観|かん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to have different views on ~

USAGE:
Do not confuse with 〜⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling/sense), which expresses a subjective impression rather than a philosophical outlook. Example: ⟦{安心感|あんしんかん}→安心感：20382_anshinkan⟧ (sense of relief) uses ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧, not {観|かん}.
